interpretation: Frozen-policy interventions, no learning. Center-logit subtracts the policy logit at state zero, setting p(right|zero)=0.5 at every state with a constant logit shift. Ignore-cart-position sets only the cart-position network input to zero. Other weights and all physical state transitions remain unchanged. Paired common random numbers match starts and per-timestep action uniforms. These interventions test causal behavior contributions, not the origin of training errors.
